home.heroTitle: Simple charm for the heart of the home
home.heroLead: Winslow Pantry brings the easy spirit of a Saturday farmer's market into your kitchen. Honest materials, cheerful color and tools that earn their spot by the stove.
home.heroAlt: Winslow Pantry packaging for the silicone utensil rest, the magnetic bag clips and the silicone funnels
home.storyTitle: Inspired by the local farmer's market
home.storyP1: You know the feeling. Crates of sweet corn, jars of honey glowing in the sun, a gingham cloth on a folding table and someone happy to tell you which peaches are ready today.
home.storyP2: Winslow Pantry grew from that feeling. Our kitchen collection pairs timeless charm with everyday function, so the tools you reach for most feel as fresh and inviting as the first market morning of the season.
home.storyAlt: A farm stand at the edge of a field, with crates of tomatoes, peppers and squash and jars of honey on a gingham covered table
home.collectionLead: Each piece is built for daily use and made to look right at home on the counter.
home.materialsTitle: Honest materials, made to be used

charm.text: Designs that feel familiar the day they arrive and still look right years from now.

function.text: Every tool has a job, and it does that job well. No gimmicks and no drawer clutter.

spirit.name: A fresh, inviting spirit
spirit.text: Color and cheerful details that make a weeknight dinner feel a little more like a Saturday.

story.heroLead: Winslow Pantry is inspired by the charm of the local farmer's market and a simpler way of living.
story.s1P1: Some of the best mornings start with a canvas bag and no real plan. You wander between stalls, taste a strawberry, chat with the grower and leave with more than you meant to buy.
story.s1P2: We wanted our kitchen to feel like that. Unhurried, generous and a little colorful. So we built Winslow Pantry around what makes the market special: honest materials, the bounty of each season and a warm welcome.
story.quote: Rooted in the bounty of color and new sensations that come with the seasons.
story.s2P1: A good kitchen tool should look lovely hanging by the stove and still work hard at six o'clock on a Tuesday. We choose bamboo, acacia and silicone because they are durable, easy to care for and pleasant to hold.
story.s2P2: Then we add the details that make you smile, like a watercolor lemon on the package or our mark engraved in the corner of a cutting board.
story.s3Alt: An acacia cutting board with the Winslow Pantry logo engraved in the corner
story.ctaText: Five pieces to start, each one ready for everyday cooking.

bamboo-utensil-set.name: Bamboo Utensil Set
bamboo-utensil-set.short: Five bamboo tools for stirring, flipping and serving.
bamboo-utensil-set.description: Smooth, lightweight bamboo that feels good in the hand. The set covers nearly everything you cook in a week, from Sunday pancakes to a big pot of chili.
bamboo-utensil-set.care: Hand wash in warm, soapy water and dry right away. Rub with a little food safe oil when the wood looks thirsty.
bamboo-utensil-set.alt: Winslow Pantry bamboo utensil set in its packaging illustrated with lemons

acacia-cutting-board.name: Acacia Cutting Board
acacia-cutting-board.short: All natural acacia wood with a groove that catches every drop.
acacia-cutting-board.description: Slice a ripe tomato or carve a roast chicken without juice running onto the counter. The groove around the edge keeps things tidy, and the warm acacia grain makes the board handsome enough to serve on.
included: One acacia cutting board with juice well
acacia-cutting-board.care: Hand wash only. Do not soak it or put it in the dishwasher. Oil now and then to keep the wood looking rich.
acacia-cutting-board.alt: Winslow Pantry acacia cutting board with a label illustrated with lemons

silicone-utensil-rest.name: Silicone Utensil Rest
silicone-utensil-rest.short: A tidy place to park your spoons while you cook.
silicone-utensil-rest.description: Rest up to four utensils at once and keep sauce off the stovetop. Flexible silicone sits steady on the counter and rinses clean in seconds.
included: One silicone utensil rest with four slots
silicone-utensil-rest.care: Dishwasher safe. You can also wash it by hand in warm, soapy water.
silicone-utensil-rest.alt: Winslow Pantry silicone utensil rest in its packaging illustrated with blueberries

silicone-funnels.name: Silicone Funnels
silicone-funnels.short: Three sizes for jars, bottles and spice tins.
silicone-funnels.description: Fill a mason jar with homemade jam, pour olive oil into a bottle or top up the salt cellar without a spill. The three sizes nest together, so they take up almost no room in the drawer.
silicone-funnels.care: Wash in warm, soapy water and let them dry before nesting.
silicone-funnels.alt: Winslow Pantry set of three silicone funnels in packaging illustrated with strawberries

magnetic-bag-clips.name: Magnetic Bag Clips
magnetic-bag-clips.short: Keep snacks fresh and clips handy on the fridge.
magnetic-bag-clips.description: Seal chips, coffee, flour and frozen peas, then stick the clips to the fridge so they are always close by. Ten clips in five easygoing colors: oat, wheat, lake blue, navy and stone.
magnetic-bag-clips.care: Wipe clean with a damp cloth.
magnetic-bag-clips.alt: Winslow Pantry magnetic bag clips in their packaging illustrated with lemons

faq.q: Where can I buy Winslow Pantry?
faq.a: Winslow Pantry is on its way to stores. Send us a note and we will let you know where to find it near you.

faq.q: Is the silicone utensil rest BPA free?
faq.a: Yes. It is BPA free, heat resistant up to 425°F (218°C) and dishwasher safe.

faq.q: How do I care for wood and bamboo?
faq.a: Hand wash, dry right away and skip the dishwasher. A little food safe oil every few weeks keeps the wood smooth and looking its best.

faq.q: Can I read this site in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Use the language menu at the top of any page to switch between English, Spanish and French.
